newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Soros seeks $140 mln Venezuela CANTV shrs - source.
newsitem.headline: Soros seeks $140 mln Venezuela CANTV shrs - source.

text.p: New York-based financial guru George Soros has placed buy orders for up $140 million worth of shares in the global offering of Venezuelan telephone company CANTV, market sources said.
Sources said Soros had bid for the shares through affiliates in New York, Buenos Aires and Caracas.

Last week, the U.K.-based publication International Financing Review wrote "market rumours suggest fund manager George Soros is in the process of placing a large order ... of between US$50 million and $80 million."
On Thursday, Venezuela's National Investment Fund (FIV) said total buy orders for the offering had so far topped $890 million.
A total of 289 million shares are to be sold, at a reference price ranging between $3.07 and $3.50, although that may later rise, FIV President Alberto Poletto has said.
Soros's presence in Venezuela already includes a 9.36 percent share in the country's largest bank, Banco Provincial, as well as a majority share in real estate company Fondo de Valores Inmobilario.
